how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-silithus-02.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:8378:completion:0: War comes, ⟦1⟧, and with it comes untold horrors. You have done all that could be asked of you and for that you should be rewarded.
rows.quest:8378:completion:1: BShould this... this prophecy ever come to pass...
rows.quest:8378:completion:3: BThe future of us all could be at an end.
rows.quest:8378:completion:4: BThese armaments will prove invaluable to your campaign in this desert.

rows.quest:8519:obj:0: Learn all that you can of the past, then speak with Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in ⟦E1⟧.⟦11⟧
rows.quest:8519:details:0: As you regain your composure and focus your gaze, you notice that something stirs within the crystal. Upon closer inspection, you realize that you are looking into the past... a memory... long forgotten.
rows.quest:8519:completion:0: After Staghelm's betrayal, I gathered the shattered pieces of the Scepter of the Shifting Sands and returned here. I had every intention of protecting the scepter from those that would seek to use it to cause harm to our world - thus was born the charge of the Dragonflights.
rows.quest:8519:completion:1: BA scepter divided amongst the four mighty Aspects would prove to be nearly impossible to restore for those willfully seeking chaos... or so I thought. What a fool I was. Even now I am hunted by that cursed flight.
rows.quest:8743:completion:0: From the ground near the gong springs a special crystal. Perhaps favor from the Brood.
rows.quest:8800:obj:0: Talk to Vargus at Cenarion Hold in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:8800:details:0: As you complete the tasks you're assigned in the war you'll want to talk to Vargus, the blacksmith. Show him any badges you've earned along the way. He'll provide you with gear to match your level of commitment to our cause.
rows.quest:8800:completion:0: Kaldon sent you? Very well, let's see what we can do for you.
rows.quest:8857:obj:0: Take the Colossus of Ashi's Husk to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.⟦12⟧
rows.quest:8857:details:0: I'm looking for battle hardened adventurers willing and able to get a fresh husk sample from the fallen Colossus of Ashi to Oglethorpe in Booty Bay. No, no, I wouldn't want you to go anywhere near that thing's corpse. Just take one of my samples and make it snappy. These things are no good to him rotten!
rows.quest:8857:completion:0: Oh the chickens I will craft from this wondrous husk! Well done, my ⟦13⟧ !
rows.quest:8858:obj:0: Take the Colossus of Regal's Husk to Overseer Oilfist in ⟦E3⟧.⟦14⟧
rows.quest:8858:details:0: There ain't nothin' I'd like more than to stuff this bug husk down Oilfist's fat face... Cept, I'm stuck here collectin' samples from that overgrown cockroach. I'll be here 'till the wee mornin' hours given the size o' that thing.
rows.quest:8858:details:1: BTake this here sample to Oilfist fer me and do it fast, ⟦15⟧. He's payin' BIG!
rows.quest:8858:details:2: BYar, Thorium Point - it be in the Searin' Gorge.
rows.quest:8858:completion:0: Excellent. We could surely devise some incredibly powerful armor from this chitin. Here's the riches you were promised.
rows.quest:8859:obj:0: Take the Colossus of Zora's Husk to Lord Maxwell Tyrosus at Light's ⟦E4⟧ Chapel in the ⟦E5⟧.⟦16⟧
rows.quest:8859:details:0: My servants were nearly killed in their efforts to recover this sample. You absolutely must hurry! Lord Maxwell Tyrosus eagerly awaits a fresh husk sample. He believes that the secrets of this Colossus could help us in the war against the Scourge!
rows.quest:8859:details:1: BWhy are you still here!? To Light's ⟦E4⟧! Yes, you will be rewarded handsomely for your efforts...⟦17⟧
rows.quest:9023:obj:0: Dirk Thunderwood at Cenarion Hold wants you to bring him Venoxis's Venom Sac and Kurinnaxx's Venom Sac.
rows.quest:9023:details:0: My brother and I run the poison operations out of the manor Ravenholdt.
rows.quest:9023:details:1: BLord Ravenholdt tasked me to track down a new and extremely effective poison compound that can be crafted from the venom sacs of the inhabitants of Zul'Gurub and the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj.
rows.quest:9023:details:2: BThere are two particularly venomous beasts residing in those blasted ruins that possess what it is that we might be looking for, ⟦19⟧. Bring me a venom sac from the beasts Kurinnaxx and Venoxis and we would be eternally grateful.
rows.quest:9023:completion:0: Ravenholdt thanks you, hero! Take your pick!
rows.quest:9248:obj:0: Aurel Goldleaf at Cenarion Hold in ⟦E2⟧ wants you to bring her 1 Abyssal Scepter. You must also be Honored with the Cenarion Circle.
rows.quest:9248:details:0: Ishnu-alah, ⟦20⟧. Show me proof of the demise of a Lord of the Abyssal Council and I shall reward you with an item that should aid you in your battles against the Qiraji.
rows.quest:9248:completion:0: Ande'thoras-ethil. It means; 'May your troubles be diminished,' in my native tongue.
rows.quest:9248:completion:1: BWear the band proudly and in good health, ⟦21⟧.
rows.quest:9415:obj:0: Speak with Marshal Bluewall at the ⟦E6⟧ encampment near Hive'Zora.
rows.quest:9415:details:0: Are you Marshal Bluewall's new recruits? Of course you are.
rows.quest:9415:details:1: BWhat are you waiting for? Good soldiers are dying in the desert. Aren't you excited to join them?
rows.quest:9415:details:2: BNow, get going and don't dry out on the way.
rows.quest:9415:completion:0: The ⟦E6⟧ needs every able body they can get. The ⟦E7⟧ has been receiving a steady supply of reinforcements from the northern part of the continent, and it's been a struggle to keep up.
rows.quest:9415:completion:1: BLet me explain the situation to you.
rows.quest:9416:obj:0: Speak with General Kirika at the ⟦E7⟧ encampment near Hive'Regal.
rows.quest:9416:details:0: You must be one of General Kirika's new recruits. It's about time you showed up. Bodies wear down quick in the desert.
rows.quest:9416:details:1: BThe dwarves have been getting reinforcements daily, and we can't afford to lose ground in our struggle for resources in ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:9416:details:2: BGet your instructions from the General. It's not my job to train you, just find you.
rows.quest:9416:completion:0: It's good that you're here, but there's no time to waste making small talk. You need instructions, and then you need to get out there.
rows.quest:9419:obj:0: Find and deliver Silithyst to the Silithyst Extractor, then speak with Marshal Bluewall at the ⟦E6⟧ encampment near Hive'Zora.
rows.quest:9419:details:0: We recently found out that the ⟦E7⟧ has been scavenging the ⟦E2⟧ desert for resources, but paid them little mind. We thought it could not be worth it to station large numbers in this sweltering desert.
rows.quest:9419:details:1: BHowever, it was discovered the importance of the resources, and now we are scrambling to catch up.
rows.quest:9419:details:2: BIf I have your assistance, you must go into the desert and recover the silithyst and return it here.
rows.quest:9419:completion:0: Thank the Light you were successful.
rows.quest:9419:completion:1: BNow if we could only have started this sooner, our need would not be so desperate. We must keep the bounty of the desert from falling into the hands of the ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:9422:obj:0: Find and deliver Silithyst to the Silithyst Extractor then speak with General Kirika at the ⟦E7⟧ encampment near Hive'Regal.
rows.quest:9422:details:0: For some time now, we have been tapping the crystal resources of the ⟦E2⟧ desert. The only dangers we faced were from the creatures that made this place their home and the oppressive sand and dust and heat.
rows.quest:9422:details:1: BBut now the ⟦E6⟧ seems to have caught on to what we have found here. It is now a race between us to capture the natural resources, and keep them from the other.
rows.quest:9422:details:2: BI need every set of hands that is available. I hope I have yours.
rows.quest:9422:completion:0: You've done well, ⟦22⟧. These resources will be added to our stockpiles, and every bit is to our gain and our enemy's loss.
